ACT VIII OF 2019
ACT VIII OF 2019
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL COURT (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Civil
Courts
Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance No. II of 1962),
in the manner hereinafter provided
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
26th August, 2019]
No.
PAB/Legis; V (13)/2019, dated 26.8.2019.---The Balochistan Civil Court (Amendment) Bill 2019 Bill No. 13 of 2019
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th August,
2019 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 19th August, 2019 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Civil Court Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance No. II of 1962), in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows;
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Civil Court (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
